title: Objects carrying specified finite ideal generators
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site, let $O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, let $I$ be an $O$-module sheaf, and let $\iota:I\to O$ be linear [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The type $\operatorname{RingedIdealGeneratingIndex}(O,I,\iota)$ consists of an object $U$, a natural number $r$, a list $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to O(U)$, and a proof that $f$ is a specified generating list of $I|_U$ through $\iota$, as defined in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generators].
